import matplotlib.pyplot as plt
import seaborn as sns
import pandas as pd
import numpy as np

# Read the data
data = """brand,model_year,megapixels,max_iso,weight_grams,price_usd,sensor_type,has_video_4k,lens_mount,body_type
Leica,2005,13.5,25600,324,811.8,Micro 4/3,1,E,Compact
Fuji,2019,46.4,51200,1151,3596.41,APS-C,0,EF,Mirrorless
Pentax,2012,38.7,12800,598,3357.2,Full Frame,0,MFT,Mirrorless
Olympus,2015,22.5,6400,1095,1555.7,APS-C,0,Z,Mirrorless
Leica,2016,12.2,25600,290,3899.09,Medium Format,0,MFT,DSLR"""

from io import StringIO
df = pd.read_csv(StringIO(data))

# Create a figure with multiple subplots
fig = plt.figure(figsize=(16, 10))
gs = fig.add_gridspec(3, 3, hspace=0.3, wspace=0.3)

# Color palette
colors = sns.color_palette("husl", len(df))

# 1. Price vs Megapixels scatter plot
ax1 = fig.add_subplot(gs[0, 0])
scatter = ax1.scatter(df['megapixels'], df['price_usd'], s=df['weight_grams']/3, 
                      c=range(len(df)), cmap='viridis', alpha=0.6, edgecolors='black', linewidth=1.5)
ax1.set_xlabel('Megapixels', fontsize=10, fontweight='bold')
ax1.set_ylabel('Price (USD)', fontsize=10, fontweight='bold')
ax1.set_title('Price vs Megapixels\n(size = weight)', fontsize=11, fontweight='bold')
ax1.grid(True, alpha=0.3)

# 2. Weight vs Price
ax2 = fig.add_subplot(gs[0, 1])
ax2.scatter(df['weight_grams'], df['price_usd'], s=100, c=colors, alpha=0.7, edgecolors='black', linewidth=1.5)
for i, brand in enumerate(df['brand']):
    ax2.annotate(brand, (df['weight_grams'].iloc[i], df['price_usd'].iloc[i]), 
                fontsize=8, ha='right', alpha=0.7)
ax2.set_xlabel('Weight (grams)', fontsize=10, fontweight='bold')
ax2.set_ylabel('Price (USD)', fontsize=10, fontweight='bold')
ax2.set_title('Weight vs Price', fontsize=11, fontweight='bold')
ax2.grid(True, alpha=0.3)

# 3. Model Year distribution
ax3 = fig.add_subplot(gs[0, 2])
bars = ax3.bar(df['brand'], df['model_year'], color=colors, alpha=0.7, edgecolor='black', linewidth=1.5)
ax3.set_xlabel('Brand', fontsize=10, fontweight='bold')
ax3.set_ylabel('Model Year', fontsize=10, fontweight='bold')
ax3.set_title('Model Year by Brand', fontsize=11, fontweight='bold')
ax3.tick_params(axis='x', rotation=45)
ax3.grid(True, alpha=0.3, axis='y')

# 4. Max ISO comparison
ax4 = fig.add_subplot(gs[1, 0])
ax4.barh(df['brand'], df['max_iso'], color=colors, alpha=0.7, edgecolor='black', linewidth=1.5)
ax4.set_xlabel('Max ISO', fontsize=10, fontweight='bold')
ax4.set_ylabel('Brand', fontsize=10, fontweight='bold')
ax4.set_title('Maximum ISO by Brand', fontsize=11, fontweight='bold')
ax4.grid(True, alpha=0.3, axis='x')

# 5. Sensor Type distribution
ax5 = fig.add_subplot(gs[1, 1])
sensor_counts = df['sensor_type'].value_counts()
wedges, texts, autotexts = ax5.pie(sensor_counts.values, labels=sensor_counts.index, 
                                     autopct='%1.1f%%', startangle=90, 
                                     colors=sns.color_palette("Set2", len(sensor_counts)))
ax5.set_title('Sensor Type Distribution', fontsize=11, fontweight='bold')

# 6. Body Type distribution
ax6 = fig.add_subplot(gs[1, 2])
body_counts = df['body_type'].value_counts()
wedges, texts, autotexts = ax6.pie(body_counts.values, labels=body_counts.index, 
                                     autopct='%1.1f%%', startangle=90,
                                     colors=sns.color_palette("Set3", len(body_counts)))
ax6.set_title('Body Type Distribution', fontsize=11, fontweight='bold')

# 7. Feature comparison heatmap
ax7 = fig.add_subplot(gs[2, :])
numeric_cols = ['megapixels', 'max_iso', 'weight_grams', 'price_usd']
heatmap_data = df[numeric_cols].T
heatmap_data.columns = df['brand'] + ' ' + df['model_year'].astype(str)
sns.heatmap(heatmap_data, annot=True, fmt='.1f', cmap='YlOrRd', 
            cbar_kws={'label': 'Value'}, ax=ax7, linewidths=1, linecolor='white')
ax7.set_title('Camera Specifications Comparison', fontsize=11, fontweight='bold', pad=10)
ax7.set_ylabel('Specification', fontsize=10, fontweight='bold')
ax7.set_xlabel('Brand & Year', fontsize=10, fontweight='bold')

plt.suptitle('Camera Dataset Analysis', fontsize=16, fontweight='bold', y=0.995)
plt.tight_layout()
plt.savefig('output.png', dpi=300, bbox_inches='tight')
plt.close()
